correctness.rationale: For every labeled C3 Cartesian Cn with n>=3, each equilibrium gives exactly one based length-n closed walk in the explicit 64-state matrix and conversely. The exact 64x64 integer characteristic polynomial factors as stated. Its 18-state strongly connected component is primitive by explicit coprime cycles of lengths 3 and 8. The only positive root larger than one of its factorization is the root of z^3-z^2-1; Perron-Frobenius gives strict spectral dominance and coefficient one. Standalone verify.py reproduces exact determinant, 18-state structure and traces; independent direct game-rule exhaustion agrees for n=3..6. Finite exhaustions alone are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Zero-or-two-neighbor best responses are a featured nonmonotone public-goods rule in the 2022-2023 complexity papers. At degree <=3 they coincide with parity, admitting linear algebra over F2. The natural width-three toroidal strip is four-regular, so its degree-four input breaks this parity reduction. The theorem gives a complete infinite-family equilibrium census, exact algebraic entropy and reproducible benchmark immediately across that structural boundary; the specific invariant is not an arbitrary finite lookup.
